rows.evidence: The cond-expr arm 0 (null) at task-state-timeline.ts:330 is taken only for a stored VerificationRound whose top-level `since` is absent. decodeNoticeOrigin returns a value without `since` only when the key is missing (decision-record-codecs.ts:381-397) and refuses a persisted null (:394); both production writers bind the cursor (commitRoundWrite writes {since:null} plus roundOriginBinding, evidence-service.ts:351-358; commitReverify does the same, :1697-1702), and preservedRoundNoticeOrigin only copies an existing origin (:305-316). encodeVerificationRoundSnapshot has no other src caller (grep: only evidence-service.ts:357, :1700). The deleted test seeded the shape raw (before/tests/work-graph/S2B-33-task-timeline-pagination.test.ts:98-116, seedRoundRaw), and TP-155 already removed the consumer's legacy branch (before/src/core/work-graph/views/task-state-timeline.ts:396-421 vs after :396-404), leaving `entry.since!` at :398. rows.proposal_note: Deleting the fallback is right; TP-155 already deleted the consumer's legacy branch. Prefer Claude's narrow form over Codex's 'tighten the source codec': in readTaskPoints refuse an absent since as rejected('unavailable') exactly as activity-read-model.ts:453 does, and type `since` as CommitCursor. Tightening the shared decodeNoticeOrigin would also change the mailbox/requeue/decision readers that still branch on an absent since. No spec line reserves the legacy no-since round (t-items-TP.md:1144 says delete).

rows.evidence: The ForbiddenError constructor (track-read-model.ts:157) executes on every throw, and one throw is reachable by public input without touching the store. validateTrackInput checks only that `sessionRefs` is an array of at most 33 (track-read-model.ts:1029-1051); scanQueries echoes the caller's ref into the bar it emits (scanOrderedOwn :802-820 keys the query-run lookup on session.sessionId only, :809-810; pushQuery is called with `session` = the asked ref at :820/:885), and sessionProblemOf then throws for a bar ref whose projectId differs from ctx.projectId (:1068-1069). The route passes plain input straight through (core-routes.ts:487, :1155; parseCoreRouteRequest validates nothing but the container, :555-590). Concrete public path: tests/work-graph/S2B-30-track-bars.test.ts:333-350 setup (asked = f.computeSessionRef(); submitAndFinishQuery(asked, goalId)), then f.readTrack({from,to,sessionRefs:[{projectId:'another-project', sessionId: asked.sessionId}]}) emits the turn bar with the foreign ref and hits :1069, i.e. new ForbiddenError -> catch :1180 returns forbidden. The agreed U (only tampering reaches it) does not hold.
rows.proposal_note: Keep the error type and the guard, but 'keep untested' (Codex) is not supportable and deleting the class (Claude) would remove a live public rejection: add the public sessionRefs test above (it also covers A2-053). The tamper-only premise both proposals rest on is refuted by the caller-supplied ref echoed into the bar.

rows.evidence: Line 1078 fires only when the Session record read at :1071-1077 has workspaceId != the Goal's workspace, so a returned bar must carry a SessionRef whose stored record lives in another workspace. Bar SessionRefs come from (a) a Run's claim/executionHistory (claimingSessionOf, activity-read-helpers.ts:176-190): claimTask refuses a target Session of another project or workspace (claim-service.ts:997-998) and the locator keeps the claiming Session (claim-record-codecs.ts:155-157; run-machine.ts:1254-1263 per T3-089); (b) gate owners from open `responsible` SessionWorkLinks: linkSessionWork's targetSession refuses another project/workspace (session-lifecycle.ts:202-213); (c) query bars: the only caller-derived ref is the asked SessionRef, but the index that emits its bars is workspace-scoped (:809-810) and the claim step refuses a QueryRun whose stored session.workspaceId differs (query-execution.ts:890), while the index path is run.executionState.sessionRef (query-record-codecs.ts:730-734). The one public path into the catch (:1069, a foreign *project* ref) throws before any Session record is read, so it cannot take :1078. Session.workspaceId is fixed to the creating scope (session-directory.ts:242-244, :276). Only a cloned/edited Session record reaches :1078, exactly as the deleted test built it (before/tests/work-graph/S2B-r4-session-workspace.test.ts:44-61 plus S2B-r3-r4-support.ts cloneSessionInWorkspace). U stands.
rows.proposal_note: The U reading is right, but Claude's recommended bundle (delete sessionProblemOf :1059-1093 with the other R4 re-checks) also deletes :1068-1069, the project-scope guard that a public sessionRefs call does reach (A2-053/A2-041 evidence). Do not remove it wholesale. Codex's keep-untested matches T3-089's refresh ('按 R-3 保留生产守卫', evidence/books/t-items-T3-w2.md:752) and t-end-list L-2; if the lead still wants this smaller, delete only the workspace read/arm (:1071-1079) and keep the project check.

rows.evidence: The catch arm 0 at :1180 handles every ForbiddenError, and one is reachable by public input with no fault and no store edit: the route passes plain input unchanged (core-routes.ts:487, :1155), validateTrackInput does not validate individual `sessionRefs` entries (track-read-model.ts:1029-1051), scanQueries emits the caller's asked ref as the query bar's sessionRef (pushQuery :787-800, called at :820/:885; index lookup :809-810 uses only session.sessionId), and sessionProblemOf throws for that ref's foreign projectId at :1068-1069. Test: use tests/work-graph/S2B-30-track-bars.test.ts:333-350 (asked = f.computeSessionRef(); submitAndFinishQuery(asked, f.goalRef.goalId)), then f.readTrack({from, to, sessionRefs:[{projectId:'another-project', sessionId: asked.sessionId}]}); the real QueryRun is found by sessionId, the bar echoes the foreign ref, :1069 throws and :1180 returns {code:'forbidden'}. The producer records are all owner-written; only the read input is out of scope, so this is G (public-step test gap), not U. Codex's reason ('ForbiddenError from an internal cross-domain record') and Claude's 'only a foreign or hand-edited record reaches this arm' miss the caller-derived ref at :1069.
rows.proposal_note: Keep the guard, but it is testable without tampering: add the public sessionRefs test above (same test covers A2-041's constructor) in tests/work-graph/S2B-30-track-bars.test.ts. Claude's 'leave untested, add to L-2' and Codex's 'no test' are both based on the U premise; T3-089's keep-the-guard refresh still applies, but L-2's 'impossible -> delete / possible -> test gap' now makes this a test gap.
